blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Retrieval-based in-context learning (ICL) enables large language models (LLMs) to predict tabular labels from similar examples, but it remains unclear whether LLM inference improves on direct voting over those same examples. We address this question by comparing four general-purpose LLMs with distance-weighted nearest-neighbor voting (Distance-KNN) using identical retrieved neighbors across 19 tabular classification datasets. With the number of demonstrations fixed, enlarging the retrieval candidate pool improves accuracy for all predictors, yet Distance-KNN achieves the highest mean accuracy at every pool size. More detailed analyses reveal that LLM gains are concentrated where retrieved neighbors exhibit low label consensus and vary across models. These gains further depend on the average feature-space distance to the test query: under low label consensus, some LLMs outperform Distance-KNN in close and intermediate neighborhoods, but all fall behind on average in the most distant group. Complementary experiments on the number of demonstrations, prompt formulation, retrieval representation, and label-balanced demonstration selection largely preserve the overall findings. These results characterize when LLM inference adds predictive value beyond distance-weighted voting in retrieval-based tabular ICL.
blocks.zh: 基于检索的内文本学习(ICL)使得大型语言模型(LLMs)能够从类似的例子中预测出表格标签,但LLM推论是否改进了对同一些例子的直接投票,仍然不清楚. 我们利用19个表格分类数据集中相同的检索邻国,将四个通用有限责任公司与距离加权近邻投票(Distance-KNN)进行比较,以解决这一问题。 随着演示次数的固定,扩大检索候选集合会提高所有预测器的准确性,而距离-KNN却在每个集合大小上达到最高的平均值精度. 更详细分析显示,LLM收益集中在回收的邻居表现出低标签共识并因模型而异的地方. 这些收益进一步依赖于测试查询的平均地物-空间距离:在低标签共识下,一些LLMS在相邻和中间相邻的地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地 关于演示次数、即时配制、检索说明和标签平衡的演示选择的补充实验在很大程度上保留了总体结论。 这些结果的特点是,LLM推论在基于检索表的ICL中增加了超出远程加权表决的预测值.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Tabular classification is a widely studied machine learning task with applications in healthcare ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , commerce ( Sun and Li, 2024 ) , and energy ( Alawi et al., 2024 ) . The goal is to predict class labels from instances described by numerical and categorical features. Traditional methods include nearest-neighbor classifiers, which predict labels from similar training instances ( Dudani, 1976 ) , and tree-based ensembles, which have demonstrated strong performance on heterogeneous tabular data ( Chen and Guestrin, 2016 ; Grinsztajn et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: Tabular分类是一项被广泛研究的机器学习任务,在保健(Yang等,2024年),商业(Sun和Li,2024年),和能源(Alawi等,2024年)方面都有应用. 目标是从由数字和绝对特征描述的实例中预测类标签. 传统方法包括近邻分类法,从类似训练中预测出标签(Dudani,1976年),以树为主的组合法,这些组合法在不同的表格数据上表现出了很强的性能(Chen和Guestrin,2016年;Grinztajn等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: Recent research has explored alternative approaches that leverage pretrained models for tabular prediction. Specialized tabular foundation models, including TabPFN, learn transferrable predictive patterns through pretraining ( Hollmann et al., 2023 ; Hollmann et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ) . Another line of work adapts language models to tabular data through supervised or instruction tuning ( Hegselmann et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Wen et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . More recently, researchers have explored applying frozen general-purpose large language models (LLMs) through few-shot in-context learning (ICL) ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Wu and Hou, 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ) . In this setting, labeled tabular instances are serialized as demonstrations, often selected according to their similarity to a test query, enabling prediction without task-specific parameter updates.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究探讨了利用预先训练过的模型进行表型预测的其他方法。 包括TabPFN在内的专门表格基础模型通过预训学习可转移的预测模式(Holmann等,2023;Holmann等,2025;Ma等,2025)。 另一行工作通过督导或指导调取来使语言模型适应表格数据(Hegselmann等,2023;Li等,2024;Wen等,2024;Zhang等,2024). 最近,研究人员通过几发针入文字学习(Brown等,2020年;Wu和Hou,2025年;Yuan等,2025年),探索应用被冻结的通用大语言模型。 在此设置中,被标注的表格实例被序列化为演示,通常根据它们与测试查询的相似性来选择,从而可以在没有特定任务参数更新的情况下进行预测.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, it remains unclear how much predictive value LLM inference adds beyond direct voting on the same retrieved examples. In retrieval-based tabular ICL, performance differences may arise from either the selection of demonstrations or the predictions made from them, making these contributions difficult to distinguish when different retrieved examples are used. Moreover, expanding the candidate pool changes the available retrieval evidence, but whether LLM inference benefits more from this change than direct voting remains unclear. Their relative performance may also depend on two characteristics of the retrieved neighborhood: label consensus, the fraction of neighbors sharing the most frequent label, and feature proximity, measured by the mean feature-space distance from the test query to those neighbors, as illustrated in Figure 1 . A controlled comparison on identical retrieved neighbors is therefore needed to assess when LLMs can provide additional predictive value.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但仍不清楚LLM推论在直接表决同一检索出的例子之后又增加了多少预测值。 在基于检索表的ICL中,表现差异可能来自选取演示或从中作出的预测,使得在使用不同的检索实例时难以区分这些贡献. 此外,扩大候选人库会改变现有的检索证据,但LLM推论是否比直接投票更能从中得益,仍不清楚。 他们的相对性能还可能取决于被检索的邻居的两个特征:标签共识,共享最频繁标签的邻居的分数,以及特征相近,以从测试查询到这些邻居的平均特征-空间距离来衡量,如图1所示. 因此,需要对相同检索的相邻区域进行有控制的比较,以评估LLMS何时能够提供额外的预测值。

blocks.en: In this work, we systematically compare four general-purpose LLMs with distance-weighted nearest-neighbor voting (Distance-KNN) across 19 tabular classification datasets using a shared-neighbor evaluation protocol. At each candidate-pool size, both predictors use the same eight retrieved examples: LLMs predict from their serialized features and labels, while Distance-KNN predicts from their labels and retrieval distances. By expanding the candidate pool while keeping the number of retrieved examples fixed, we examine their performance and how LLM gains vary with label consensus and feature proximity. Our results show that Distance-KNN achieves the highest mean accuracy across all evaluated candidate pools, while LLMs exhibit selective gains under low label consensus. Feature proximity further distinguishes these gains, with improvements occurring in selected close and intermediate neighborhoods but disappearing in the most distant ones.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们系统比较了四个通用的LLMs和19个表格分类数据集的远程加权近邻投票(Distance-KNN),使用共享近邻评价协议. 在每一个候选库规模上,两个预测器都使用相同的八个检索出的例子: LLMs从它们的序列特征和标签中预测出,而远程-KNN则从它们的标签和检索距离中预测出. 通过扩大候选人才库,同时保留取回的示例数量,我们审查它们的性能以及LLM如何因标签共识和特征相近而变化。 我们的结果显示,远程网络在所有被评价的候选人才库中都实现了最高平均准确度,而有限责任公司则在低标签共识下有选择地取得了收益。 地物相近进一步区分了这些收益,某些近邻和中间邻里出现了改善,但在最远的邻里却消失了.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows: 1) We present a systematic shared-neighbor comparison of four frozen LLMs and Distance-KNN across 19 datasets, enabling a direct assessment of the contribution of LLM inference over distance-weighted voting. 2) We find that Distance-KNN achieves the highest mean accuracy across all evaluated candidate pools, while LLMs exhibit selective gains in low-consensus neighborhoods that vary with feature proximity. 3) We further examine how the number of demonstrations, prompt formulation, retrieval representation, and label-balanced demonstration affect the comparison, finding that the advantage of Distance-KNN largely persists across these experiments.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献如下: 1) 我们通过19个数据集对4个被冻结的有限责任公司和远程KNN进行系统、共享的邻国比较,从而能够直接评估LLM推论对远程加权表决的贡献。 2) 我们发现,远程网络在所有被评价的候选人才库中达到最高平均准确度,而LLMS在低共识区显示出选择性的增益,这些增益随地物相近而变化。 3) 我们进一步研究演示、即时配制、检索说明和标签平衡演示的数量如何影响比较,发现在这些试验中,远程KNN的优点基本上依然存在。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Tabular prediction has traditionally relied on distance-based methods such as k-nearest neighbors (KNN) and tree-based ensembles, including Random Forest, XGBoost, and CatBoost ( Cover and Hart, 1967 ; Breiman, 2001 ; Chen and Guestrin, 2016 ; Prokhorenkova et al., 2018 ) . To circumvent task-specific training while achieving strong generalization across unseen datasets, recent work has introduced tabular foundation models. For instance, TabPFN is pretrained on synthetic tabular tasks to make predictions directly from labeled examples ( Hollmann et al., 2023 ; Hollmann et al., 2025 ) . Extending this paradigm to real-world data, TabDPT introduces a dedicated tabular architecture for in-context prediction, rather than adapting general-purpose LLMs ( Ma et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: A common paradigm relies on additional training to adapt language models for tabular prediction. Existing methods fine-tune LLMs on serialized rows for few-shot classification ( Hegselmann et al., 2023 ) , train on synthetic table tasks ( Li et al., 2024 ) , or leverage diverse tabular datasets for cross-dataset transfer ( Wen et al., 2024 ; Gardner et al., 2024 ) , while others explore retrieval-guided tuning ( Wen et al., 2025 ) and structure-aware parameter adaptation ( He et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, our study investigates tabular prediction using frozen, general-purpose LLMs without additional task-specific training, leveraging Distance-KNN to provide a controlled comparison on identical retrieved demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 一个共同的范式依赖于额外的培训来使语言模型适应表型预测. 现有方法对序列化行的LLMs进行微调,用于几发分级分类(Hegselmann等,2023年),对合成表任务的培训(Li等,2024年),或利用多种表格数据集进行跨数据集传输(Wen等,2024年;Gardner等,2024年),而其他人则探索了取回-引导调取(Wen等,2025年)和结构-意识参数适应(He等,2025年). 与此相反,我们的研究利用冷冻的、通用的有限责任公司进行表格预测,而无需额外的特定任务培训,利用远程-KNN提供对相同检索演示的可控比较。

blocks.en: In-context learning (ICL) enables LLMs to adapt to new tasks using a few labeled demonstrations without fine-tuning ( Brown et al., 2020 ) . Subsequent studies have examined how models exploit these demonstrations, analyzing the effects of input distributions ( Min et al., 2022 ) , label mappings ( Zhao et al., 2021 ; Sun et al., 2025 ) , and prompt formatting ( Peng et al., 2025 ) . Demonstration selection has also been widely explored through semantic similarity ( Liu et al., 2022 ) , learned retrieval ( Rubin et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , and influence estimation ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Du et al., 2025 ) . In tabular classification, Wu and Hou (2025) propose a training-free retrieval-based approach that prompts LLMs with relevant labeled examples, while InsightTab distills task-specific insights and combines them with selected demonstrations for classification ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) . However, these studies primarily investigate how retrieval strategies or additional information can improve LLM predictions. In contrast, our work compares frozen LLMs with Distance-KNN using identical retrieved neighbors, revealing when LLM inference provides additional predictive value and how these gains depend on neighborhood structure of demonstrations.

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: For each test query, a shared retriever extracts the k k nearest (most similar) labeled training instances based on feature-space distance. Distance-KNN predicts from their labels and metric distances, whereas the LLM receives their serialized features and labels followed by the query features. By scaling the candidate-pool size under a fixed demonstration budget ( k = 8 k=8 ), we compare their predictive behaviors on identical retrieved evidence (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 对于每个测试查询,一个共享检索器会根据特征-空间相距提取最接近(最相近)的标记为训练的 kk. 距离-KNN从其标签和公尺距离中预测出,而LLM则得到它们的序列特征和标签,然后是查询特征. 通过在固定的演示预算(k = 8 k = 8)下缩放候选集合大小,我们比较了他们在相同检索出的证据上的预测行为(图2 ).

blocks.en: 3.1 Models
blocks.zh: 3.1 模式

blocks.en: We evaluate four open-weighted LLMs: Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B chat models ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , alongside instruction-tuned Gemma3-12B and Gemma3-27B ( Gemma Team et al., 2025 ) . All generative LLMs are deployed locally via vLLM without quantization. Qwen3-Embedding-4B ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) is employed for text embedding retrieval in § 5 . Throughout our experiments, Distance-KNN serves as the reference predictor, using the exact same retrieved neighbors as the LLMs. Full checkpoint identifiers and implementation details are provided in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价4个开放式减量课程:Qune3-8B和Qune3-32B 聊天模式(Yang等,2025年),与指令调制Gemma3-12B和Gemma3-27B(Gemma Team等,2025年)并列. 所有基因的LLMs都是通过vLLM在当地部署的,没有量化. Qwen3-Embedding-4B(Zhang等人,2025a)用于第5节中文本嵌入检索. 在整个实验中,远程KNN作为参考预测器,使用与LLMS完全相同的被检索邻居. 完整的检查站识别资料和执行细节见附录A.1。

blocks.en: 3.2 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集

blocks.en: We experiment on 19 public tabular classification datasets from UCI Machine Learning Repository ( Kelly et al., 2023 ) and OpenML ( Vanschoren et al., 2014 ) . These datasets span binary and multiclass tasks across diverse domains, including healthcare, education, finance, industry, and software engineering. Each dataset is partitioned into training, validation, and test splits with the ratio of 8:1:1 via stratified sampling. All predictors share identical splits within each random seed. The training split serves as the retrieval candidate pool. We report macro-averaged accuracy across all datasets to prevent large test sets from dominating aggregate evaluation. Dataset statistics are detailed in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们从UCI机器学习存储器(Kelly等,2023年)和OpenML(Vanschoren等,2014年)对19个公共表格分类数据集进行了实验. 这些数据集涵盖保健、教育、金融、工业和软件工程等不同领域的二进制和多类任务。 每个数据集通过分层采样被分入训练,验证,测试分出比例为8:1. 所有预测者在每个随机种子中共享相同的分数. 培训分期进行,作为检索候选人人才库。 我们报告所有数据集的宏观平均准确性,以防止大型测试集主导总体评价。 数据集统计数据详见附录A.2。

blocks.en: 3.3 Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.3 议定书

blocks.en: Feature types are determined from the training split. Integer-valued numerical features with at most 20 unique values are treated as categorical. Numerical features are standardized via Z-score normalization, with imputation and standardization statistics fitted strictly on the current candidate pool.
blocks.zh: 特征类型由培训分期确定。 最多具有20个独特值的整数值特征被视为绝对值。 数字特征通过Z分数正常化实现标准化,计算和标准化统计数据严格贴在目前的候选人库上。

blocks.en: For each dataset and random seed, we construct a fixed candidate sequence shared by all test queries and predictors. To ensure initial class coverage, we first randomly draw one training example from each class, and then sample remaining examples in proportion to class frequencies. Candidate pools of size n ∈ { 16 , 32 , 64 , 128 , 256 , 512 } n\in\{16,32,64,128,256,512\} are formed as nested prefixes of this sequence, with the full pool comprising the entire training split. For any query x x , let N k ​ ( x , P n ) N_{k}(x;P_{n}) denote the k k nearest neighbors retrieved from pool P n P_{n} .

Demonstrations are serialized as feature key–value pairs with their ground-truth labels and ordered from nearest to farthest, followed by the query features. Predictions are obtained greedily (temperature 0 0 ) from label-token log-probabilities. blocks.en: 4 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4 结果和讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Do LLMs Outperform Distance-KNN as the Candidate Pool Expands?
blocks.zh: 4.1 作为候选人人才库扩展的LLMs是否超越了远程KNN?

blocks.en: Larger candidate pools improve all predictors, but Distance-KNN maintains the highest mean accuracy. Figure 3 summarizes the comparison across seven candidate-pool sizes with the retrieval budget fixed at k = 8 k=8 . As shown in Figure 3 (a), mean accuracy increases consistently for all methods as the candidate pool expands, with Distance-KNN maintaining the highest accuracy at every pool size. Distance-KNN improves from 72.81% at 16 candidates to 85.50% at the full pool, while the strongest LLM, Gemma3-27B, follows a similar trajectory, rising from 72.73% to 85.26%. These results indicate that larger candidate pools benefit both approaches, but do not yield an aggregate accuracy advantage for LLM inference over distance-weighted voting.
blocks.zh: 较大的候选集合改进了所有的预测器,但远程-KNN保持了最高的平均值. 图3汇总了七个候选人库规模与固定在k=8克=8的检索预算的比较。 如图3(a)所示,随着候选人才库的扩大,所有方法的平均准确度不断提高,远程-KNN在每一个人才库规模上都保持最高的准确度。 距离-KNN从16名候选人的72.81%提高到了整个人才库的85.50%,而最强的LLM,Gemma3-27B,也遵循了类似的轨迹,从72.73%上升到85.26%. 这些结果表明,较大的候选人集合对这两种办法都有利,但不能使LLM推论对远距离加权投票产生总的准确性优势。

blocks.en: Distance-KNN also leads in mean rank and wins, although its advantage over the strongest LLM is marginal. Figure 3 (b–c) further shows that Distance-KNN attains the lowest mean rank (2.03) and the highest wins (6.5) at the full pool, compared with 2.24 and 6.0 for Gemma3-27B. Paired comparisons in Table 1 show that Distance-KNN significantly outperforms three of the four LLMs after Holm correction, further substantiating its effectiveness. These results indicate that LLM inference does not improve mean accuracy over Distance-KNN, motivating a closer examination of how their relative performance varies with label consensus among the retrieved examples. Full-pool dataset-level accuracies are reported in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 距离-KNN也以中位数领先并取胜,尽管它相对于最强LLM的优势是边际的. 图3(b-c)还显示,远距离KNN的中位数最低(2.03),而Gemma3-27B的中位数最高(6.5)。 表1中的比较表明,在Holm修正之后,远程通信网络的绩效大大超过四个有限责任公司中的三个,进一步证明了其有效性。 这些结果表明,LLM推论并没有比远程KNN提高平均准确性,从而促使人们更仔细地审查它们的相对性能如何因检索实例中的标签共识而有所不同。 附录B.1报告了全库数据集水平的速率。

blocks.en: Low label consensus creates selective opportunities for LLM gains. At the lowest reported consensus level ( 4 / 8 4/8 ), three of the four LLMs surpass Distance-KNN with positive mean accuracy gaps, led by Gemma3-27B showing the largest improvement of 3.60 percentage points. Qwen3-8B, however, falls behind Distance-KNN, indicating that low consensus does not benefit all models equally. The override analysis in Appendix B.2 shows that beneficial corrections outweigh harmful overrides for the three improving models. These results suggest that some LLMs can leverage information in mixed-label demonstrations beyond what is captured by distance-weighted voting.
blocks.zh: 低标签共识为LLM收益创造了选择性的机会. 在报告的最低共识水平(4/8 4/8)下,四个有限责任公司中有三个公司以正差准确度差距超过远程网络,由Gemma3-27B牵头,显示最大的改进为3.60个百分点。 然而,Qune3-8B却落后于距离-KNN,这表明低共识并不能平等地惠及所有模式. 附录B.2中的超标分析显示,有益的更正超过了三个改进模型的有害超标。 这些结果表明,一些有限责任公司在混合标签演示中可以利用信息,超出远程加权投票所获取的信息。

blocks.en: High label consensus favors Distance-KNN. Across consensus levels of 5 / 8 5/8 – 7 / 8 7/8 , Distance-KNN consistently outperforms all evaluated LLMs. The most pronounced deficit occurs for Qwen3-8B, which trails Distance-KNN by 9.91 percentage points at 5 / 8 5/8 consensus, while Gemma3-27B remains the closest competitor throughout this range. As detailed in Appendix B.2 , harmful overrides exceed beneficial corrections across all models in these groups. This suggests that LLM inference can disrupt useful local evidence when the retrieved examples exhibit a high label consensus. At full label consensus ( 8 / 8 8/8 ), both types of overrides become rare, and the accuracy gaps approach zero.
blocks.zh: 高标签共识支持远程KNN. 在5/8 5/8 = 7 / 8 7/8的协商一致水平上,远程网络的业绩一直高于所有经评价的有限责任公司。 最明显的赤字发生在Qwen3-8B上,在5/8 5/8的共识下,它跟随了距离-KNN的9.91个百分点,而Gemma3-27B仍然是整个范围内最接近的竞争对手. 如附录B.2所详述,这些类别中所有模型的有害重置超过了有益的更正。 这表明,当检索到的例子显示出高度的标签共识时,LLM推论可能会干扰有用的本地证据. 在完全标签共识(8 / 8 8/8 )中,两种类型的超能都变得罕见,而准确性差距接近于零.

blocks.en: The benefits of LLM inference are concentrated in low label consensus neighborhoods and depend on the model, whereas higher label consensus generally favors distance-weighted voting.
blocks.zh: LLM推论的好处集中在低标签的共识邻里,并依赖于模型,而更高的标签共识一般倾向于远程加权投票.

blocks.en: Under low label consensus, feature proximity further distinguishes LLM gains and losses. At ≤ 4 / 8 \leq 4/8 consensus, three LLMs outperform Distance-KNN in the closest stratum (0–20 percentile), with Gemma3-27B reaching a gain of 8.1%. Notably, all four LLMs achieve positive gaps at the intermediate 40–60 percentile, showing that the advantages are not restricted to the closest neighborhoods. Conversely, all four models fall behind Distance-KNN at the most distant 80–100 percentile, with accuracy gaps ranging from − 9.8 % -9.8\% to − 1.6 % -1.6\% . These results indicate that feature proximity helps characterize LLM gains under label disagreement, although closer neighbors do not consistently yield larger advantages.

blocks.en:
LLM gains largely disappear at higher label consensus, regardless of proximity. At 5 / 8 5/8 – 7 / 8 7/8 consensus, Distance-KNN outperforms the LLMs in 58 of the 60 model–proximity combinations, including nearly all cases involving the closest neighbors. The only two positive gaps occur for Gemma3-27B, indicating that proximity alone is insufficient to recover a consistent LLM advantage when label consensus increases. At full consensus ( 8 / 8 8/8 ), the absolute accuracy gaps shrink to at most 0.7% across all models and proximity strata.
Together, these findings suggest that feature proximity is most informative for distinguishing LLM gains under low label consensus, while higher consensus consistently limits such gains across proximity levels.

LLMs benefit from selected close and intermediate neighborhoods but consistently fall behind Distance-KNN in the most distant ones. These gains remain model-dependent and largely disappear as label consensus increases.

blocks.en: 5 Complementary Analyses
blocks.zh: 5 补充分析

blocks.en: We conduct four complementary analyses to examine how the number of demonstrations, prompt formulation, retrieval representation, and label-balanced selection affect the comparison between LLM inference and distance-weighted voting. All experiments cover 19 datasets and three seeds using Gemma3-12B and Qwen3-8B. The first two analyses retain feature-based nearest-neighbor retrieval, while the latter two examine alternative retrieval representations and label-balanced selection, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了四项补充性分析,以审查示威次数、迅速表述、检索表述和标签平衡选择如何影响LLM推论和远程加权投票的比较。 所有实验都覆盖了19个数据集和3个使用Gemma3-12B和Qune3-8B的种子. 前两项分析保留了基于地物的近邻检索,而后两项分析分别审查了替代性检索说明和标签平衡选择。

Results show that mean accuracy increases with candidate-pool size for all predictors across three demonstration budgets, consistent with the results in Figure 3 . Increasing k k benefits Gemma3-12B more consistently than Qwen3-8B, while Distance-KNN shows no further improvement beyond eight neighbors. Overall, the main findings in Section 4.1 remain largely consistent across demonstration budgets, with limited exceptions at small candidate pools. Additional results are provided in Appendix C.1 .

blocks.en: To examine whether the default prompt formulation limits LLM performance, we compare three formulations: key–value serialization (KV), natural-language serialization (NL), and rule-augmented natural-language serialization (Rule-Augmented NL). Our main experiments use KV, which presents features as key–value pairs, whereas NL expresses them as natural-language statements. Rule-augmented NL further supplements NL with training-derived classification rules using a procedure adapted from InsightTab ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) . All three formulations use the same eight retrieved demonstrations and their order, with additional rules supplied only in Rule-Augmented NL.

Gemma3-12B generally performs best with KV, with only minor differences among formulations. In contrast, Qwen3-8B consistently benefits from NL and Rule-Augmented NL over KV, with the latter achieving a notable accuracy gain of 3.53% at 64 candidates. These observations indicate that prompt formulation can improve LLM predictions, but the performance gap identified in § 4.1 is not solely attributable to the default prompt formulation. Prompt templates and rule construction are detailed in Appendix C.2 .

blocks.en: We compare the default feature-space retrieval (as defined in § 3.3 ) with text-embedding retrieval, which represents serialized tabular instances using Qwen3-Embedding-4B. Table 2 reports the full-pool comparison, with results across all candidate-pool sizes in Appendix Table 7 . Feature-space retrieval achieves higher mean accuracy for all three predictors at every evaluated pool size. At the full pool, switching to text-embedding retrieval reduces accuracy by approximately 16 percentage points for both Distance-KNN and Gemma3-12B, and by 24.20 points for Qwen3-8B. Despite these changes, Distance-KNN maintains the highest mean accuracy under both retrieval representations. These results extend § 4.1 by showing that retrieval representation strongly influences prediction quality, but changing the retrieval space does not lead to a consistent advantage for LLM inference.

blocks.en: To complement our analyses of label consensus and feature proximity in § 4.2 and § 4.3 , we compare the nearest eight demonstrations with eight label-balanced examples selected from the nearest 32 candidates at full training pools. Table 3 shows that this strategy reduces mean accuracy by 7.49 and 10.58 percentage points for Gemma3-12B and Qwen3-8B, respectively, with declines on all 19 datasets. Unlike naturally occurring low-consensus neighborhoods examined earlier, this procedure increases label diversity by replacing some nearby examples with more distant ones, changing both label consensus and feature proximity. These results indicate that enforcing label balance does not improve LLM accuracy compared with nearest-neighbor selection.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We investigate whether and when LLMs add predictive value beyond distance-weighted voting on the same retrieved tabular examples. Across 19 datasets and expanding candidate pools, Distance-KNN achieves the highest mean accuracy at every pool size, although its margin over the strongest LLM is small. Some LLMs outperform voting under low label consensus, with gains varying by model and feature proximity. As label consensus increases, Distance-KNN generally retains the advantage, and low-consensus gains do not extend to the most distant neighborhoods. Complementary analyses indicate that changing the number of demonstrations, prompt formulation, retrieval representation, or label-balanced selection does not substantially alter these findings. Our work highlights the importance of comparing LLMs against traditional classifiers on the same retrieved examples and motivates further work on identifying the neighborhoods in which LLMs are most useful.
blocks.zh: 我们调查LLMs是否和何时在同一个检索到的表格中的例子上增加超出远程加权表决的预测值。 在19个数据集和不断扩大的候选集合中,远程网络在每一个集合规模上都实现了最高的平均值精确度,尽管其相对于最强LLM的比值很小. 一些LLMS在低标签共识下投票的成绩胜出,收益因模式而异并具有相近性. 随着标签共识的增加,距离-KNN一般保留了优势,而低共识收益并不延伸到最远的街区. 补充分析表明,改变演示次数、迅速配制、检索表示或标签平衡选择不会大大改变这些结论。 我们的工作强调,必须在同一检索到的例子上,将法学硕士与传统分类人员进行比较,并激励开展进一步工作,确定法学硕士最有用的社区。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our study focuses on the predictive value of general-purpose LLMs given the same retrieved neighbors as Distance-KNN. Although this design controls demonstration selection, it does not evaluate independently optimized end-to-end systems or task-specific model adaptation. Moreover, while our evaluation spans 19 diverse datasets, validating whether these behavioral patterns generalize to other emerging tabular benchmarks or highly domain-specific datasets remains a promising direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究侧重于一般用途的LLMs的预测值,因为与Treater-KNN相同的检索邻居。 虽然这种设计控制了演示选择,但并不独立评价优化的端到端系统或特定任务模式的适应性. 此外,虽然我们的评价涉及19个不同的数据集,但验证这些行为模式是通向其他新出现的表格基准还是高度针对具体领域的数据集,仍然是未来工作的有希望的方向。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Our study uses publicly available benchmark datasets and existing pretrained language models, involving no new data collection or human annotation. Our experiments aim to provide empirical insights into retrieval-based tabular prediction rather than establish the suitability of these methods for real-world deployment. Downstream applications in sensitive domains would require additional evaluation of reliability and fairness.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究使用公开的基准数据集和现有的预先训练的语言模型,不涉及新的数据收集或人类注释。 我们的实验旨在对基于检索的表格预测提供实证见解,而不是确定这些方法是否适合现实世界的部署。 在敏感领域的下游应用需要额外评估可靠性和公正性。

blocks.en: KV uses feature key–value pairs; NL uses statements of the form “the {feature} is {value}”; Rule-Augmented NL augments NL with rules from labeled candidate-pool data. All conditions share the same eight retrieved examples, labels, and order, and use three seeds.
blocks.zh: KV 使用特性密钥 - 值对; NL 使用“ {feature} 为 {value} ” 的表单语句; 规则- 增强的 NL 增加了 NL , 并带有标签候选人集合数据的规则 。 所有条件都共享相同的八个被检索的例子,标签和顺序,并使用三个种子.

blocks.en: For Rule-Augmented NL, we adapt the Summarize–Exemplify–Reflect rule-distillation procedure of InsightTab ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) . For each dataset, seed, and candidate pool, a class-balanced subset of up to 128 samples trains an auxiliary XGBoost classifier (100 trees, maximum depth 6, learning rate 0.3, exact tree method). The first tree’s leaves define sample groups. Predictive entropy guides the selection of eight low-entropy examples and a high-entropy subset containing approximately half of the selected samples, with selection aiming to balance classes.
blocks.zh: 对规则强化的NL来说,我们修改了InsightTab(袁等,2025年)的总结-解释-参考规则的简化程序。 对于每个数据集,种子,和候选池,一个由多达128个样本组成的类平衡子集会训练一个辅助XGBoost分类器(100棵树,最大深度6个,学习速率0.3,精确树法). 第一棵树的树叶界定了样本组. 预测性 en指向选择8个低诱因的例子和一个高诱因子集,包含大约一半被选择的样本,选择旨在平衡类别.

blocks.en: The classification checkpoint (google/gemma-3-12b-it or Qwen/Qwen3-8B) also summarizes and merges group-wise rules. Using these rules and the low-entropy examples, it predicts the high-entropy examples; errors and their correct labels support one additional round of rule generation. XGBoost assists rule construction, while the LLM makes the final test predictions.
blocks.zh: 分级检查站(google/gemma-3-12b-it或Quen/Quen3-8B)也总结并合并了分组规则. 使用这些规则和低通例,它预测出高通例;出错及其正确的标签支持另外一回合的规则生成. XGBooost协助规则构建,而LLM则进行最终测试预测.

blocks.en: Rules are JSON objects with one to three feature conditions joined by AND and a predicted class. Generated, merged, and additional rules are evaluated on the entire current candidate pool. Acceptance requires support ≥ 3 \geq 3 , coverage ≥ 0.01 \geq 0.01 , precision ≥ 0.70 \geq 0.70 , and a 95% Wilson lower bound ≥ 0.40 \geq 0.40 ; this empirical lower bound replaces the rule confidence. Unparseable outputs produce no rules, invalid rules are discarded, and an empty retained set gives empty rule arrays in the prediction template.
blocks.zh: 规则是带有一至三个特征条件的JSON对象,加之并有预测类. 产生、合并和补充规则在目前所有候选人库中进行评价。 接受需要支持 ^ 3\ geq 3,覆盖 ^ 0.01\ geq 0.01,精度 ^ 0.70\ geq 0.70,95%的 Wilson 下限 ^ 0.40\ geq 0.40;这种经验性下限取代了规则信任. 不可分割输出不产生规则,无效的规则被丢弃,一个空保留集在预测模板中给出了空规则数组.

blocks.en: Construction, validation, and refinement use training features and labels only. Rules are cached per dataset, seed, candidate pool, and model configuration, then reused across test queries. The construction examples do not replace the eight retrieved demonstrations. Rule-generation requests use temperature 0 0 and at most 512 output tokens; input sections for summarization, merging, and reflection are limited to 24,000 characters, with excess content omitted or truncated. Final classification uses temperature 0 0 and first-token label log-probabilities. LLM parameters remain frozen; only the auxiliary XGBoost model is trained.
